senses.gloss: Caus. P. To excite, stimulate, instigate, stir up, animate, provoke.

p. p. 
__1 Landed, crossed, passed over. 
__2 Rescued, delivered. 
__3 Released from obligation. 
__4 One who has finished his course of studies; experienced, clever.

f. [अव्-क्तिन् [[P. III. 3. 97]]] 
__1 Weaving, sewing (fr. वे). 
__2 Protection; मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः [[Mahānār. Up. 20. 4.]] 
__3 Enjoyment. 
__4 Sport, play अबैति जन्तुः कुमनीष ऊतीः [[Bhāg. 1. 3. 37]]; 8. 5. 44. 
__5 Favour, kindness. 
__6 Aid, assistance, help. 
__7 The money given to a tailor for sewing. 
__8 Wish, desire; मन्बन्तराणि सद्धर्मऊतयः कर्मवासनाः [[Bhāg. 2. 10. 4.]] 
__9 Red texture; tissue; अत्र सर्गो विसर्गश्च स्थानं पोषणमूतयः [[Bhāg. 2. 10. 1.]]
